title: West Build Pool
description: West-side build pool log with concrete coordinates, Minecraft server responses, local correction, scaffold tagging, and reusable action extraction.

messages.text: West build pool mounted plan/west.json. Server endpoint is 127.0.0.1:25565; diffs go to workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001/world/west.diff.jsonl.
messages.systemLog: west-foreman INFO connect minecraft://127.0.0.1:25565 bot_prefix=west scope=x[-24,-1] y[63,95] z[-18,21]

messages.text: builder-01 starts the base ring, builder-02 takes the roof bands with checkpoint pauses, and builder-03 lays temporary path markers only where the job file requests them.
messages.systemLog: west-foreman INFO assigned builder-01:1648 blocks builder-02:2195 blocks builder-03:978 blocks tmp_allowed=true

messages.text: Base ring placement started at y=63. I checked the centerline offset and am leaving x=0 untouched.
messages.systemLog: builder-01 stdout placed=240 failed=0 last=(-18,63,-12) checkpoint=foundation_alignment pending

messages.text: Roof row 02 does not line up with the exported queue: expected z=-7 but the placed edge is at z=-8. Pausing this slice before mirroring uses it.
messages.systemLog: builder-02 WARN mismatch job=west_roof_row_02 expected=(-11,78,-7) observed=(-11,78,-8); lock=x[-16,-9],y[78],z[-9,-6]

messages.text: Confirmed it is a local offset from mesh simplification. Apply a one-block inward shift only to the next seven roof placements and keep the completed base unchanged.
messages.systemLog: west-foreman INFO patch wrote plan/patches/west_roof_row_02.json affected=7 base_hash_unchanged=true resume=builder-02

messages.text: The upper roof face needs access blocks. I placed oak scaffolds tagged tmp/scaffold/west-01 so they can be removed by ID later.
messages.systemLog: builder-01 stdout temp_place tag=tmp/scaffold/west-01 count=18 material=minecraft:scaffolding cleanup_after=verify

messages.text: North walkway markers are down and marked as tmp/path/north-03. They are outside the architecture layer and should not appear in final_world.schem.
messages.systemLog: builder-03 stdout temp_place tag=tmp/path/north-03 count=13 material=minecraft:yellow_wool purpose=bot_navigation

messages.text: The same line placement happened 18 times without failure. I am saving the bounded helper as place_line with explicit start/end/material checks.
messages.systemLog: skill-cache INFO append logs/skills.jsonl name=place_line source=builder-02 samples=18 guards=bounds,air_check,rollback

messages.text: Using place_line for the remaining uniform west roof ribs. Corners and scaffold-adjacent cells stay manual.
messages.systemLog: west-foreman INFO skill_call place_line region=west roof_rows=9 skipped_high_risk=14 exit=0

messages.text: West side is done. Diff, patch record, temporary tag list, and skill-cache updates have been flushed to disk.
messages.systemLog: west-foreman INFO complete placed=4821 corrected=7 temp=31 diff=world/west.diff.jsonl log=logs/west-build.log
